rules: Independently bind all nine retained source files per volume by exact bytes and SHA-256.

Reconcile every scandata leaf against its retained JP2; all 1070 access-format leaves map to PDFs/OCR OBJECTs, unique scan-only leaves 306/307 add two text pages, and every other non-access image has an explicit disposition.
Bind the local Tesseract v5.5.0.20241111 derived OCR witness to volume II JP2 leaf images 306/307, preserve uncorrected wording, and verify its exact place between access-format leaves 305 and 308.
Check every OCR paragraph, line, source ID, heading role, page type, printed label, front/body/back placement, and facsimile PDF target against the actual readable TEI.
Validate the TEI P5 XSD and challenge omission, duplication, order, wording, volume, page-target, and section mutations.
Reconstruct in a fresh process and compare candidate member bytes; keep unresolved scan/wording and deleted-leaf gaps visible.
